metadata.title: Geometric ideal triangulations of hyperbolic 3-manifolds
metadata.abstract: We resolve the longstanding geometric ideal triangulation conjecture arising from Thurston's theory of hyperbolic 3-manifolds: every finite-volume cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold admits a finite geometric ideal triangulation realizing its complete hyperbolic structure.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 双曲三流形的几何理想三角剖分
analysis.workSummary: 作者声称证明每个有限体积尖点双曲三流形都有实现其完整双曲结构的有限几何理想三角剖分。
analysis.breakthrough: 针对 Thurston 理论中长期的几何理想三角剖分问题给出肯定解答。
analysis.limitations: 命题限于有限体积尖点情形；重大结论目前按作者摘要呈现，具体构造与非退化性需以正文为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 针对 Thurston 理论中长期的几何理想三角剖分问题给出肯定解答。
